Regulation: B.C. Reg. 84/2026
Made under: Business Corporations Act
Published in: No. 10 – B.C. Regs. 83 to 93, June 2, 2026
Deposit date: May 22, 2026

B.C. Reg. 84/2026, deposited May 22, 2026, under theBUSINESS CORPORATIONS ACT[section 433],BUSINESS PRACTICES AND CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT[section 196],FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS ACT[section 289],REAL ESTATE SERVICES ACT[sections 89.2 (6) and 130] andSECURITIES ACT[section 183]. Order in Council 197/2026, approved and ordered May 22, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, effective October 13, 2026, (a)	the Business Corporations Regulation, B.C. Reg. 65/2004, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 1, (b)	the Disclosure of the Cost of Consumer Credit Regulation, B.C. Reg. 273/2004, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 2, (c)	the Insurance Licensing Exemptions Regulation, B.C. Reg. 328/90, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 3, (d)	the Real Estate Services Regulation, B.C. Reg. 506/2004, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 4, (e)	the Real Estate Services Rules, B.C. Reg. 209/2021, are amended as set out in the attached Schedule 5, and (f)	the Securities Rules, B.C. Reg. 194/97, are amended as set out in the attached Schedule 6. — B. BAILEY,Minister of Finance; L. BEARE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section S6.2 of Table 2 of the Business Corporations Regulation, B.C. Reg. 65/2004, is amended (a)	by striking out "a person whose registration in any capacity has been cancelled" and substituting "any of the following:", (b)	by repealing paragraph (a) and substituting the following: (a)	a person whose registration in any capacity has been cancelled under theSecurities Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 418, by the Securities Commission or the executive director;, (c)	in paragraph (b) by adding "a person whose registration in any capacity has been cancelled" before "under theMortgage Brokers Act", and (d)	by adding the following paragraph: (c)	a person whose licence has been cancelled under theMortgage Services Act, S.B.C. 2022, c. 27, by (i)	the superintendent under that Act, or (ii)	the Financial Services Tribunal established under theFinancial Institutions Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 141. 2	Section S6.3 (a) and (b) of Table 2 is amended by adding "or licence" after "the registration". 1	Section 13 (1) of the Disclosure of the Cost of Consumer Credit Regulation, B.C. Reg. 273/2004, is amended

minutes_briefs.title: BC updates corporate, credit, insurance, real estate and securities rules effective October 13, 2026
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has passed a regulation (B.C. Reg. 84/2026) that updates several provincial rules affecting businesses. The changes touch on the Business Corporations Act, consumer credit disclosure, insurance licensing, real estate services, and securities. Most of the updates are technical, such as clarifying who is barred from certain roles (e.g., people whose licences or registrations have been cancelled) and aligning wording across different laws. The changes take effect on October 13, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Review the specific schedules of B.C. Reg. 84/2026 to see if your business's licensing, registration, or disclosure practices are affected before October 13, 2026.
